excerpt.zh: 在调查母星系时，我们在[From.GetName]上面找到了一些东西，和我们早先从母星上观测的结果间存在一定的偏差。
excerpt.en: During the survey of our home system we found something on [From.GetName] that did not match earlier observations made from our homeworld.

triggers.en: Placed on a planet by an event
